news.title: The Elite Series heads from Hamburg to Bangkok, Las Vegas and Lyon
news.summary: The official 2026/27 schedule opens in Hamburg on 30–31 October, followed by London, Bangkok, Las Vegas and Lyon. Elite 15 and Challenger 15 races share the stage on the road to Hong Kong 2027.
news.take: The useful lesson for everyday racers is planning: pick the event, then build the weeks backwards from it.

news.title: Singapore, Melbourne and Hong Kong offer an overseas start line
news.summary: The official calendar lists Singapore on 26–29 November, Melbourne on 9–13 December and Hong Kong on 7–10 January. Travel, sleep and recovery need the same attention as the race plan.
news.take: Paul's travel-heavy race history makes the practical side matter: arrive with a plan, not just a ticket.

news.title: Elite qualification switches to a rolling points system
news.summary: HYROX's framework uses a rolling 365-day window: the best five singles results or best three doubles results count. Elite Series doubles partners must share the same nationality and an active athlete licence is required.
news.take: The points table matters, but the calendar still has to fit real training and real life.

news.title: Hong Kong to host the 2027 World Championships
news.summary: HYROX announced the first World Championships in the Asia-Pacific region, at Hong Kong's AsiaWorld-Expo on 10–13 June 2027.
news.take: A big target is useful when it turns into manageable sessions this week.

news.title: Project Podium opens a new route to athlete support
news.summary: PUMA announced a programme offering men's, women's and adaptive solo podium finishers at the 2026 World Championships the opportunity to become PUMA athletes for the following season.
news.take: Support matters, but the day-to-day work still decides who gets close enough to use it.

faq.json.note: Paul Gillingham answers — practical guidance, with pricing and diary details confirmed directly.

items.a: Paul's public coaching routes are linked here — the application form and Rox Lyfe plans. Exact pricing stays on those official pages.

items.q: I've never done HYROX — can I join?
items.a: Yes. Paul's coaching covers beginners through experienced racers; the application asks for your starting point, goal and available training time.
8km of running split by 8 workout stations — SkiErg, sled push, sled pull, burpee broad jumps, rowing, farmers carry, sandbag lunges and wall balls. Same format worldwide.
Paul is based around Crawley in West Sussex and coaches remotely. Use the application or Linktree for the current coaching route.
Confirmed dates sit on the Race Calendar & Travel page, sourced from the official HYROX listings.

items.q: Can you find me a doubles partner?
items.a: Use Find a Race-mate to post your division and pace. Paul's race history includes dozens of HYROX partners, so matching is part of the community offer.

items.q: Do you programme for races abroad?
items.a: Yes — remote coaching and race-weekend planning are part of the offer. Paul's own racing has covered the UK, Europe and international championship events.
Use Paul's coaching application, open his Linktree for the current routes, or leave a question through Ask Paul.
